The '''LEC 2019 Summer Split''' was the second split of the 2019 [[League of Legends European Championship season]], organized by Riot Games and held from June 7 to September 8, 2019. Ten permanent partner teams competed in a Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo1}} Group Stage, followed by a Single Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} Playoffs to determine the European champion. The winner of the split qualified for the [[World Championship/2019|2019 World Championship]] as Europe’s representative.

This split continued the franchised LEC format introduced in [[LEC/2019/Spring|Spring]], maintaining the same ten permanent teams with no relegation. Matches were held in Berlin, Germany, and the Playoffs concluded at the Nikos Galis Olympic Indoor Hall in Athens, Greece.

==Format==
* '''Group Stage''' - ''June 7 - August 10''
**Double Round Robin
**Each team plays 18 matches
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}
**1st to 6th place will play the playoffs
***1st and 2nd place are seeded into Round 3
*** 3rd to 6th place are seeded into Round 1
* '''Playoffs''' - ''August 23 - September 8''
** Single Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
** Winner Qualifies for [[World Championship/2019|World Championship 2019]]
